      "content": "## Page 1\n\n&lt;img&gt;ZWO logo&lt;/img&gt;\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD.\nAddress: Building#2, Peninsula Life Plaza, Moon bay road 6#, SuZhou Industrial Park, JiangSu , China\nContact: +86 0512 65923102\n\n# 苏州振旺光电\n## 赤道仪通信协议\n### ZWO Mount Serial Communication Protocol\n\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>版本</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n<th>日期</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>V1.0</td>\n<td>初版</td>\n<td>2022/7/11</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>V1.0</td>\n<td>Original edition</td>\n<td>2022/7/11</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n\n## 目录\n\n*   通信连接说明 3\n*   通信协议说明 3\n*   日期和时间命令 5\n*   位置坐标命令 5\n*   移动命令 6\n*   跟踪和导星命令 9\n*   同步命令 10\n*   归零命令 10\n*   复合命令 10\n*   常规使用流程 11\n\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD. &lt;page_number&gt;1&lt;/page_number&gt; &lt;page_number&gt;1&lt;/page_number&gt;\n\n---\n\n\n## Page 2\n\n&lt;img&gt;ZWO logo&lt;/img&gt;\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD.\nAddress: Building#2, Peninsula Life Plaza, Moon bay road 6#, SuZhou Industrial Park, JiangSu , China\nContact: +86 0512 65923102\n\n*   通信连接说明\n\n客户端使用串口连接赤道仪时，通信波特率为 9600\n\n客户端通过手柄的 WIFI AP 网络连接赤道仪时，连接 IP:192.168.4.1,PORT:4030\n\n**About the connection**\n\nCommunication to the mount via serial cable is 9600.\nWireless communication to the mount via the WIFI of the hand controller: IP 192.168.4.1, PORT 4030.\n\n*   通信协议说明\n\n协议基于 LX200 并且兼容 LX200\n\n**About the Protocol**\n\nThe Protocol is based on LX200 also compatible with LX200.\n\n协议规则如下:\n\n命令格式以\":\"开头，中间是命令码，以\"#\"结尾，如\":AA#\".\n\nCommands usually start with \":\" and end with \"#\", such as \":AA#\". Fields in the middle represent the command itself.\n\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD. &lt;page_number&gt;2&lt;/page_number&gt; &lt;page_number&gt;2&lt;/page_number&gt;\n\n---\n\n\n## Page 3\n\n&lt;img&gt;ZWO logo&lt;/img&gt;\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD.\nAddress: Building#2, Peninsula Life Plaza, Moon bay road 6#, SuZhou Industrial Park, JiangSu , China\nContact: +86 0512 65923102\n\n命令码格式 Command format\n\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>起始字符</th>\n<th>命令码</th>\n<th>结束字符</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>Starting character</td>\n<td>Command Code</td>\n<td>Ending character</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>:</td>\n<td>nnn</td>\n<td>#</td>\n<td>n 表示一个字符,命令码不超过 62 字节</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>:</td>\n<td>nnn</td>\n<td>#</td>\n<td>N represents one character. The whole length of a command code does not exceed 62 characters.</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n\n命令返回格式 Command response format\n\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>移动命令</th>\n<th>或者非法命设置参数命令令</th>\n<th>GOTO 命令</th>\n<th>获取跟踪状态命令</th>\n<th>获取参数命令</th>\n<th>同步命令</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>Moving Command or Illegal Command</td>\n<td>Configuring Settings Command</td>\n<td>GOTO Command</td>\n<td>Getting Tracking Status command</td>\n<td>Getting Current Settings command</td>\n<td>Sync Command</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>无返回</td>\n<td>1: 正确<br>0: 错误</td>\n<td>0 成功<br>e+错误码#</td>\n<td>0# 跟踪未开启<br>1# 跟踪进行中<br>e+错误码#</td>\n<td>以#结尾的字符串</td>\n<td>N/A#<br>e+错误码#</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>No response</td>\n<td>1: Success<br>0: False</td>\n<td>O Success<br>e+ error code</td>\n<td>O# Tracking off<br>1# Tracking on<br>e+ error code</td>\n<td>Strings ended with #,</td>\n<td>N/A#<br>e+ error code</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD. &lt;page_number&gt;3&lt;/page_number&gt; &lt;page_number&gt;3&lt;/page_number&gt;\n\n---\n\n\n## Page 4\n\n&lt;img&gt;ZWO logo&lt;/img&gt;\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD.\nAddress: Building#2, Peninsula Life Plaza, Moon bay road 6#, SuZhou Industrial Park, JiangSu , China\nContact: +86 0512 65923102\n\nsuch as :\nsDD*MM:SS#\n\n下文中出现下面的字符为通配符\nCharacters below are wildcards.\n\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>通配符 Wildcard</th>\n<th>说明 Statement</th>\n<th>举例 Example</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>s</td>\n<td>+或者-</td>\n<td>:SGsHH# (:SG-08#)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td></td>\n<td>+ or -</td>\n<td></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>HH:MM:SS</td>\n<td>小时:分钟:秒</td>\n<td>:SLHH:MM:SS# (:SL19:44:32#)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td></td>\n<td>Hour:Minute:Second</td>\n<td></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>MM/DD/YY</td>\n<td>月份/日/年</td>\n<td>:SCMM/DD/YY# (:SC06/08/22#)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td></td>\n<td>Month/Date/Year</td>\n<td></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>n</td>\n<td>数字</td>\n<td>:Rn# (:R9#)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td></td>\n<td>Number</td>\n<td></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>x</td>\n<td>字母或者数字</td>\n<td>xxx# (78e36d441524#)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td></td>\n<td>Letter or number</td>\n<td></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>&</td>\n<td>分割多个参数</td>\n<td>MM/DD/YY&sHH:MM:SS&sHH:MM#</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td></td>\n<td>Separete multiple parameters</td>\n<td></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n\n命令返回值分 4 种情况\nThere are 4 kinds of command response values.\n\n1) 无返回。某些命令不需要返回值，例如移动指令。\n\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD. &lt;page_number&gt;4&lt;/page_number&gt; &lt;page_number&gt;4&lt;/page_number&gt;\n\n---\n\n\n## Page 5\n\n&lt;img&gt;ZWO logo&lt;/img&gt;\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD.\nAddress: Building#2, Peninsula Life Plaza, Moon bay road 6#, SuZhou Industrial Park, JiangSu , China\nContact: +86 0512 65923102\n\n2) 返回 0, 或 1。该返回用来表示命令指向成功或失败，GOTO 命令使用 0 表示成功，其他命令使用 1 表示成功。\n\n3) 返回 0, 或 1, e+错误码+#, 如 e1#, 数字 1 代码错误码，可以在下面错误码说明查看具体原因。\n\n4) 返回字符串+#结尾。如 HH:MM:SS#, 该返回用来返回数据。\n\n5) 返回 N/A#或者 e+错误码# (同步命令)\n\n注意：以 G 开头的获取命令，返回值都会带有#\n\n1) No response. Some commands do not require response values, such as moving commands.\n2) Response 0 or 1. It stands for success or failure of the command. Success for GOTO commands is 0, for other commands is 1.\n3) Response 0 or 1 or e+ error code+#. For example, e1#, the number 1 stands for error code. You can check the explanation below to see the reason.\n4) Response character string ends with +#. For example, HH:MM:SS#, it was used to response data.\n5) Response N/A# or e+ error code# (Sync commands).\nNote: The response values of Get Commands starting with G all comes with #.\n\n错误码说明:\n\nError code statement:\n\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>错误码</th>\n<th>说明</th>\n<th>Statement</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>1</td>\n<td>参数超出范围</td>\n<td>Parameter beyond the range</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>2</td>\n<td>参数格式错误</td>\n<td>Parameter format error</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>3</td>\n<td>在归零，slew，goto 的状态时，执行 GOTO 会返回该错误码</td>\n<td>When the mount is going to the zero position, or slewing or doing GOTO, carrying out GOTO will response this error code.</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>4</td>\n<td>设备正在移动中</td>\n<td>Equipment moving</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD. &lt;page_number&gt;5&lt;/page_number&gt; &lt;page_number&gt;5&lt;/page_number&gt;\n\n---\n\n\n## Page 6\n\n&lt;img&gt;ZWO logo&lt;/img&gt;\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD.\nAddress: Building#2, Peninsula Life Plaza, Moon bay road 6#, SuZhou Industrial Park, JiangSu , China\nContact: +86 0512 65923102\n\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th></th>\n<th></th>\n<th></th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>5</td>\n<td>目标低于地平线</td>\n<td>Target under horizon line</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>6</td>\n<td>目标低于高度限制</td>\n<td>Target under height limitation</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>7</td>\n<td>未同步时间地点</td>\n<td>Time and position not synchronized</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>8</td>\n<td>跟踪过了中天</td>\n<td>Meridian has been passed over in tracking</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n\n● 赤道仪/经纬仪切换命令\n\n命令： “:AP#”\n\n返回： None\n\n说明： 切换到赤道仪模式\n\n命令： “:AA#”\n\n返回： None\n\n说明： 切换到经纬仪模式\n\n注意： 切换模式后， 需要重启赤道仪\n\nEquatorial/Altazimuth mode switching command\n\nCommand: “:AP#”\nResponse: None\nStatement: Switch to Equatorial mode\n\nCommand: “:AA#”\nResponse: None\nStatement: Switch to Altazimuth mode\nNote: You need to reboot the mount after mode switched.\n\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD. &lt;page_number&gt;6&lt;/page_number&gt; &lt;page_number&gt;6&lt;/page_number&gt;\n\n---\n\n\n## Page 7\n\n&lt;img&gt;ZWO&lt;/img&gt;\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD.\nAddress: Building#2, Peninsula Life Plaza, Moon bay road 6#, SuZhou Industrial Park, JiangSu , China\nContact: +86 0512 65923102\n\n● **日期和时间命令**\n\n注意：连接上赤道仪后，需要先设置经纬度，时区，本地时间后，赤道仪才可以正常工作。\n\n**Date/time command**\n\nNote: You need to set the longitude and latitude, time zone and local time after the mount is turned on to ensure it can work properly.\n\n命令：“:SCMM/DD/YY#”\n\n返回：“1: 正确， 0: 错误”\n\n说明：设置日期\n\nCommand: “:SCMM/DD/YY#”\nResponse: “1: Success, 0: False”\nStatement: Set date.\n\n命令：“:GC#”\n\n返回：“MM/DD/YY#”\n\n说明：获取日期\n\nCommand: “:GC#”\nResponse: “MM/DD/YY#”\nStatement: Get date.\n\n命令：“:SLHH:MM:SS#”\n\n返回：“1: 正确， 0: 错误”\n\n说明：设置时间\n\nCommand: “:SLHH:MM:SS#”\nResponse: “1: Success, 0: False”\nStatement: Set time.\n\n命令：“:GL#”\n\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD. &lt;page_number&gt;7&lt;/page_number&gt; &lt;page_number&gt;7&lt;/page_number&gt;\n\n---\n\n\n## Page 8\n\n&lt;img&gt;ZWO logo&lt;/img&gt;\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD.\nAddress: Building#2, Peninsula Life Plaza, Moon bay road 6#, SuZhou Industrial Park, JiangSu , China\nContact: +86 0512 65923102\n\n返回: “HH:MM:SS#”\n\n说明: 获取时间\n\nCommand: “:GL#”\nResponse: “HH:MM:SS”\nStatement: Get time.\n\n命令: “:GS#”\n\n返回: “HH:MM:SS#”\n\n说明: 获取恒星时\n\nCommand: “:GS#”\nResponse: “HH:MM:SS#”\nStatement: Get sidereal time.\n\n命令: “:GH#”\n\n返回: “1: 夏令时开启, 0: 夏令时未开启”\n\n说明: 获取夏令时配置信息\n\nCommand: “:GH#”\nResponse: “1: Summer time on, 0: Summer time off”\nStatement: Get the Summer time setting.\n\n命令: “:SHn#”\n\n返回: “1”\n\n说明: 配置夏令时, n 取值范围为 0-1; 0 代表关闭夏令时, 1 代表打开夏令时\n\nCommand: “:SHn#”\nResponse: “1”\nStatement: Set Summer time. n’s value: 0~1; 0 stands for turning off Summer time. 1 stands for turning on Summer time.\n\n*   位置坐标命令\n\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD. &lt;page_number&gt;8&lt;/page_number&gt; &lt;page_number&gt;8&lt;/page_number&gt;\n\n---\n\n\n## Page 9\n\n&lt;img&gt;ZWO&lt;/img&gt;\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD.\nAddress: Building#2, Peninsula Life Plaza, Moon bay road 6#, SuZhou Industrial Park, JiangSu , China\nContact: +86 0512 65923102\n\n命令: “:SGsHH#”\n\n返回: “1: 正确, 0: 错误”\n\n说明: 设置时区 (小时), 小写字母 s 代表符号 (-/+), 东八区设置为 SG-08#, 西区反而是正的\n\n**Position/coordinates commands:**\n\nCommand: “:SGsHH#”\n\nResponse: “1: Success, 0: False”\n\nStatement: Set time zone (hour). The lowercase s indicates symbol (-/+). UTC +8 is set to SG-08#. The western time zones use negative offset.\n\n命令: “:SGsHH:MM#”\n\n返回: “1: 正确, 0: 错误”\n\n说明: 设置时区 (小时:分钟), 同上一个命令基本一样, 增加了分钟设置, 目的是支持一些非整数时区的国家, 比如印度 UTC+5:30\n\nCommand: “:SGsHH:MM#”\n\nResponse: “1: Success, 0: False”\n\nStatement: Set time zone (hour: minute). This command is basically the same as last command, but with an extra minute setting for countries like India whose time zone is UTC +5:30.\n\n命令: “:GG#”\n\n返回: “sHH:MM#”\n\n说明: 获取时区\n\nCommand: “:GG#”\nResponse: “sHH:MM”\nStatement: Get time zone.\n\n命令: “:StsDD*MM:SS#”\n\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD. &lt;page_number&gt;9&lt;/page_number&gt; &lt;page_number&gt;9&lt;/page_number&gt;\n\n---\n\n\n## Page 10\n\n&lt;img&gt;ZWO logo&lt;/img&gt;\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD.\nAddress: Building#2, Peninsula Life Plaza, Moon bay road 6#, SuZhou Industrial Park, JiangSu , China\nContact: +86 0512 65923102\n\n返回: “1: 正确, 0: 错误”\n\n说明: 设置纬度, 小写字母 s 代表符号 (-/+), 例如: 设置北纬 31°15'24\" (:St+31*15:24#)\n\nCommand: “:StsDD*MM:SS#”\n\nResponse: “1: Success, 0: False”\n\nStatement: Set latitude. The lowercase s indicates symbol (-/+), for example: N 31°15'24\"(:St+31*15:24#).\n\n命令: “:Gt#”\n\n返回: “sDD*MM:SS#”\n\n说明: 获取纬度\n\nCommand: “:Gt#”\nResponse: “sDD*MM#”\nStatement: Get latitude.\n\n命令: “:SgsDDD*MM:SS#”\n\n返回: “1: 正确, 0: 错误”\n\n说明: 设置经度, 小写字母 s 代表符号 (-/+), DDD (000°-180°), MM (00'-59'), SS (秒值: 0-59)\nCommand: “:SgsDDD*MM:SS#”\n\nResponse: “1: Success, 0: False”\n\nStatement: Set longitude. The lowercase s indicates symbol (-/+). DDD (000°-180°), MM (00'-59'), SS (Second: 0-59).\n\n命令: “:Gg#”\n\n返回: “sDDD*MM:SS#”\n\n说明: 获取经度\n\nCommand: “:Gg#”\nResponse: “sDDD*MM#”\nStatement: Get longitude.\n\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD. &lt;page_number&gt;10&lt;/page_number&gt; &lt;page_number&gt;10&lt;/page_number&gt;\n\n---\n\n\n## Page 11\n\n&lt;img&gt;ZWO logo&lt;/img&gt;\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD.\nAddress: Building#2, Peninsula Life Plaza, Moon bay road 6#, SuZhou Industrial Park, JiangSu , China\nContact: +86 0512 65923102\n\n命令: “:Gm#”\n\n返回: “E(东), W(西), N(无朝向, 即零位)”\n\n说明: 获取赤道仪朝向\n\nCommand: “:Gm#”\nResponse: “E(East), W(West), N(No direction. Home/zero position)”\nStatement: Get the current cardinal direction of the mount.\n\n● 移动命令\n\n命令: “:SrHH:MM:SS#”\n\n返回: “1: 正确, 0: 错误”\n\n说明: 设置目标 RA\n\nMoving commands:\nCommand: “:SrHH:MM:SS#”\nResponse: “1: Success, e2#: False”\nStatement: Set target RA\n\n命令: “:Gr#”\n\n返回: “HH:MM:SS#”\n\n说明: 获取目标 RA\n\nCommand: “:Gr#”\nResponse: “HH:MM:SS#”\nStatement: Get target RA\n\n命令: “:SdsDD:MM:SS#”\n\n返回: “1: 正确, 0: 错误”\n\n说明: 设置目标 DEC, 小写字母 s 代表符号 (-/+), DD (代表多少度), MM (代表角分, 1 度 = 60 角分), SS (代表角秒, 1 角分 = 60 角秒)\n\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD. &lt;page_number&gt;11&lt;/page_number&gt; &lt;page_number&gt;11&lt;/page_number&gt;\n\n---\n\n\n## Page 12\n\n&lt;img&gt;ZWO logo&lt;/img&gt;\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD.\nAddress: Building#2, Peninsula Life Plaza, Moon bay road 6#, SuZhou Industrial Park, JiangSu , China\nContact: +86 0512 65923102\n\nCommand: \":SdsDD:MM:SS#\"\n\nResponse: \"1: Success, e2#: False\"\n\nStatement: Set target DEC. The lowercase s indicates symbol (-/+). DD indicates degree. MM indicates arcminute (1° = 60 arcminutes). SS indicates arcsecond (1 arcminute = 60 arcseconds).\n\n命令: \":Gd#\"\n\n返回: \"sDD*MM:SS#\"\n\n说明: 获取目标 DEC\n\nCommand: \":Gd#\"\nResponse: \"sDD*MM:SS#\"\nStatement: Get target DEC\n\n命令: \":GR#\"\n\n返回: \"HH:MM:SS#\"\n\n说明: 获取当前 RA\n\nCommand: \":GR#\"\nResponse: \"HH:MM:SS#\"\nStatement: Get current RA of mount.\n\n命令: \":GD#\"\n\n返回: \"sDD*MM:SS#\"\n\n说明: 获取当前 DEC\n\nCommand: \":GD#\"\nResponse: \"sDD*MM:SS#\"\nStatement: Get current DEC of mount.\n\n命令: \":GZ#\"\n\n返回: \"DDD*MM:SS#\"\n\n说明: 获取方位角\n\nCommand: \":GZ#\"\n\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD. &lt;page_number&gt;12&lt;/page_number&gt; &lt;page_number&gt;12&lt;/page_number&gt;\n\n---\n\n\n## Page 13\n\n&lt;img&gt;ZWO&lt;/img&gt;\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD.\nAddress: Building#2, Peninsula Life Plaza, Moon bay road 6#, SuZhou Industrial Park, JiangSu , China\nContact: +86 0512 65923102\n\nResponse: “DDD*MM:SS#”\nStatement: Get Azimuth\n\n命令: “:GA#”\n\n返回: “sDD*MM:SS#”\n\n说明: 获取高度角\n\nCommand: “:GA#”\nResponse: “sDD*MM:SS#”\nStatement: Get altitude\n\n命令: “:MS#”\n\n返回: “0: 正确, e+错误码+#”\n\n说明: GOTO\n\n注意: 必须同步过时间地点后才可以进行 GOTO, 在归零, slew, goto 的状态时发送 GOTO 指令会返回 e3#。\n\nCommand: “:MS#”\n\nResponse: “1: Success, e2#: False”\n\nStatement: GOTO\nNote: The mount will not be able to GOTO before time and position get synchronized. &lt;page_number&gt;17&lt;/page_number&gt;\n\n---\n\n\n## Page 18\n\n&lt;img&gt;ZWO logo&lt;/img&gt;\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD.\nAddress: Building#2, Peninsula Life Plaza, Moon bay road 6#, SuZhou Industrial Park, JiangSu , China\nContact: +86 0512 65923102\n\n返回: None\n\n说明: 使用月亮速跟踪\n\nCommand: \":TL#\"\nResponse: None\nStatement: Use lunar tracking rate.\n\n命令: “:GT#”\n\n返回: “0#, 1#, 2#”\n\n说明: 获取跟踪速度 (0: 恒星速, 1: 月亮速, 2: 太阳速)\n\nCommand: \":GT#\"\nResponse: \"1#, 2#, 3#\"\nStatement: Get tracking rate (0: Sidereal rate, 1: Solar rate, 2: Lunar rate).\n\n命令: “:Te#”\n\n返回: “1: 正确, 0: 错误”\n\n说明: 开始跟踪\n\n注意: 返回失败可以通过:GAT#命令来获取跟踪失败原因\n\nCommand: \":Te#\"\nResponse: \"1: Success, 0: False\"\nStatement: Start tracking.\nNote: If failed in starting tracking, you can get the failure reason through command :GAT#.\n\n命令: “:Td#”\n\n返回: “1: 正确, 0: 错误”\n\n说明: 停止跟踪\n\n注意: 在归零, slew, goto 的状态下会返回失败\n\nCommand: \":Te#\"\nResponse: \"1: Success, 0: False\"\n\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD. &lt;page_number&gt;18&lt;/page_number&gt; Successfully GOTO target.\nNormal conditions of tracking off - It has already been turned off manually; Mount in zero position.\nAbnormal conditions of tracking off - Target below the horizon line; Meridian has been passed over in tracking; Time and position are not synchronized (Altazimuth mount).\n\n命令: “:Mgdnnnn#”\n返回: None\n说明: 导星, d (e\\w\\s\\n) 代表方向东、西、南、北 nnnn (0000-3000) 代表导星时间, 单位 ms\n\nCommand: “:Mgdnnnn#”\nResponse: None\nStatement: Guiding. d (e\\w\\s\\n) indicates direction east, west, south, north. nnnn (0000-3000) indicates guiding rate (unit: ms).\n\n命令: “:Rg0.nn#”\n返回: None\n说明: 设置导星速度,数值范围为 0.10-0.90\n\nCommand: “:Rg0.nn#”\nResponse: None\nStatement: Set guiding rate from 0.10 to 0.90.\n\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD. &lt;page_number&gt;19&lt;/page_number&gt; &lt;page_number&gt;20&lt;/page_number&gt;\n\n---\n\n\n## Page 21\n\n&lt;img&gt;ZWO logo&lt;/img&gt;\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD.\nAddress: Building#2, Peninsula Life Plaza, Moon bay road 6#, SuZhou Industrial Park, JiangSu , China\nContact: +86 0512 65923102\n\n● **复合命令**\n\n命令: “:SMGEsDD*MM:SS&sDDD*MM:SS#”\n\n返回: “1: 正确, 0: 错误”\n\n说明: 设置纬度, 经度\n\n**Compound commands:**\n\nCommand: “:SMTIMM/DD/YY&HH:MM:SS&sHH:MM#”\nResponse: “1: Success, 0: False”\nStatement: Set latitude and longitude.\n\n命令: “:GMGE#”\n\n返回: “sDD*MM:SS&sDDD*MM:SS#”\n\n说明: 获取纬度, 经度\n\nCommand: “:GMGE#”\nResponse: “sDD*MM&sDDD*MM#”\nStatement: Get longitude and latitude.\n\n命令: “:SMTIMM/DD/YY&HH:MM:SS&sHH:MM#”\n\n返回: “1: 正确, 0: 错误”\n\n说明: 设置日期, 时间, 时区\n\nCommand: “:SMTIMM/DD/YY&HH:MM:SS&sHH:MM#”\nResponse: “1: Success, 0: False”\nStatement: Set date, time and time zone.\n\n命令: “:GMTI#”\n\n返回: “MM/DD/YY&HH:MM:SS&sHH:MM#”\n\n说明: 获取日期, 时间, 时区\n\nCommand: “:GMTI#”\nResponse: “MM/DD/YY&HH:MM:SS&sHH:MM#”\nStatement: Get date, time and time zone.\n\nSUZHOU ZWO CO., LTD. &lt;page_number&gt;21&lt;/page_number&gt;
